title: JC de Vera, Shaina Magdayao star in reimagined ‘Florante at Laura’; trailer debuts in Busan
summary: The film adaptation of Filipino poet Francisco Balagtas' classic piece invites audiences to rediscover a story of love, betrayal, and the courage to overcome division.
